_comment: Quality floors enforced by CI (scripts/check_eval.py) on every pull request.
These are deliberately data, not code: ratcheting a floor up after a real
improvement is a one-line diff that shows in review, and loosening one to
make a build pass is equally visible.
Set on 2026-09-21 against the first measured run of the real warehouse:
day F1 0.723, day precision 0.895, incident recall 0.900, cluster precision
0.818, rules accuracy 1.000, mean delay 0.22d. The pipeline is deterministic
from ACH_SEED, so the only expected drift is float formatting across
platforms -- hence small margins rather than generous ones.
llm_triage_accuracy is absent on purpose: CI has no model, so triage runs
rules-only there. The LLM number is measured on the build machine.
